description: This file contains a JUnit test case for verifying the handling of illegal or malformed CBOR binary values using Jackson's CBOR dataformat library. It specifically tests the behavior of parsing a byte array that represents an invalid CBOR binary value, expecting a JsonParseException to be thrown.

classes.name: CborIllegalValuesTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing handling of illegal or malformed CBOR binary data, ensuring exceptions are correctly thrown and processed.

methods.name: binaryValue
methods.description: Test method that generates a CBOR binary value, then attempts to read it back expecting an exception due to illegal value.
